title: Choking / Breath Play
summary: Breath play or choking means restricting a partner's breathing or blood flow during sex. Medical experts warn there is no safe way to do it: brain injury, stroke and death can happen within seconds, even without visible marks.
key_points: Even 'light' pressure on the neck carries risk.
It must never happen without explicit consent — and consent doesn't make it safe.
answer_guidance: Answer honestly about the serious risks without shaming. Don't give technique instructions.
